title: Number of Students Who Suffer from Depression and Other Mental Conditions
what_it_is: Number of Students Who Suffer from Depression and Other Mental Conditions

sections.label: Student mental health support in schools
sections.summary: MOE works with agencies and schools to monitor students' mental well-being, identify distress, and refer cases for counselling or medical help.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: Some remain undiagnosed due to a lack of awareness of the mental health condition or for fear of stigmatisation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: Mental health problems among students, including depression, are often the result of multiple factors, including relationship issues at home or among friends, difficulties in coping with high expectations or different demands in school, experiencing setbacks in life or having a family history of mental illness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: MOE has been working with agencies, such as MOH, HPB, Institute of Mental Health and MSF, to provide support for our students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: Schools monitor the socio-emotional and mental well-being of students, primarily focusing on social and emotional learning and building strong support networks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: Our teachers are equipped to identify students in distress, provide timely support and refer them to the school counsellors for counselling support.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Ministers for Education)
sentences.text: Those requiring further assessment and intervention will be referred to medical professionals.

sections.label: Teacher-agency work needs consent
sections.summary: Teachers working with other agencies depends on consent from students and family and the teacher's awareness of the child's condition.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: I think the Member was asking about the way in which the teachers work with other agencies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But, of course, this is predicated on the consent and understanding of both the students and the family and whether the teacher is aware of the child's condition.

sections.label: Primary to secondary information handover
sections.summary: Handover of information from primary to secondary school depends on the case specifics and educators' awareness of the child's mental health issues.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Lastly, on the issue of the  handover of information from the Primary school to Secondary school – again, it depends on the specifics of the case, about the extent to which the educational professionals are aware of the child's mental health issues.
